comment: No family is set on the signal input or the four outputs: the module passes through whatever is patched, audio or CV alike. The slew is a one-pole approach with a floor of 0.8ms, which is there to stop a mute clicking rather than to be heard (ratio.cpp:77). A muted output still shows its would-be level on the display, darkened, rather than collapsing to nothing.
